summary_raw: May 4: Stocks mixed, oil surging on US-Iran conflict reports; conflicting reports of Iranian attack on US warship in Strait of Hormuz. May 1: Nasdaq hit record 25,114.44 (+0.89%), S&P 500 record 7,230.12 (+0.29%) on Apple earnings beat. PLTR, STX, EBAY notable movers.
